decisions.reason: Grounded in console-split-chunks.txt: the entry mermaid-chunk.js served 200 but statically imports per-diagram siblings that were not shipped, so a failed sibling import rejects the whole dynamic import and the code-block fallback fires. Proposes shipping the full chunk closure or emitting one self-contained chunk (inlineDynamicImports / splitting:false / manualChunks).

Compares chunk-route.ts and ci-note.md: LIB_DIR from fileURLToPath/import.meta.url preserves uppercase E: while realpathSync on win32 returns a lowercased e: drive letter, so the ordinal startsWith rejects a genuinely contained file; explains Linux passes and the laptop case matched by luck, and explicitly rejects the 'Windows paths are unreliable' folklore without overclaiming realpath behavior.

Proposes realpath of both sides then path.relative containment rejecting empty, ..-prefixed and absolute results, with win32-only case folding as platform-appropriate semantics; realpath on both sides also closes junction/symlink escapes. Separately requires a JavaScript content-type for module MIME strictness (plus same-origin, no HTML redirect). Does not disable the guard.

Explains both handlers act on the same Ctrl+wheel: the event bubbles from the diagram to the pane/document/window ancestor listener, so one gesture drives both; assigns exclusive ownership to the open modal via preventDefault plus stopPropagation, requires the pane handler to stand down (target-inside-modal check, no capture/window listener while modal open), and correctly notes later stopPropagation cannot undo ancestor capture.

Planned (not claimed executed) checks cover all three: a build-time chunk-closure/self-containment test plus a smoke import for incident 1; a case-differing Windows path expecting 200 with traversal, sibling-prefix and symlink cases refused, plus a JS content-type contract test, for incident 2; and a DOM test asserting modal zoom changes while pane font-size is unchanged and defaultPrevented, for incident 3.

caps.reason: The final advice strengthens containment (realpath both sides plus path.relative with traversal/escape rejection); no recommendation disables the guard or serves paths outside the plugin lib root.
